items.why: The fear gauge is spiking as stocks slide broadly and headlines point to a pivotal week for AI ahead of Nvidia results.
AI stocks are sliding, with Nvidia leading the group lower ahead of its results, and AMD is caught in the same selloff.
Headlines say Nvidia is leading AI stocks lower as the Nasdaq slides ahead of its results in a pivotal week for AI.
Big tech is sliding as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq drop ahead of a pivotal week for AI.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 2.34% and S&P futures down 1.61%, with oil down 2.88%.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday afternoon, with the Nasdaq down about 2% as Nvidia leads AI stocks lower ahead of its results. The VIX is up over 15% as investors brace for a pivotal week for AI.
